title: A customer can buy something end to end
problem_statement: A customer of this single Thai merchant cannot complete a purchase without staff mediating it by phone or chat. Buying end to end means signing in, holding a cart, seeing a total the merchant stands behind, having the stock actually held, paying, and being able to see what happened.
business_value: Customers complete purchases unassisted on the web, which is the merchant's first direct online sales channel and the thing the adoption and funnel KPIs in gap-closed 3.1 and 3.2 measure.
why_now: This is the merchant's first online storefront; today every order is mediated by phone or chat.

success_criteria.metric: registration to first purchase within 7 days
success_criteria.target: measured from launch as the adoption baseline

success_criteria.measurement_method: every total recomputed server-side at confirm (gap-closed 4.6)

success_criteria.metric: double-charge or double-reserve on a duplicate signal

success_criteria.measurement_method: stock invariant checked under concurrent confirm (gap-closed 5.4)

decoupling.rationale: A customer buying something is one indivisible business outcome. An account with nothing to buy, a cart that cannot hold stock, and a checkout with no payment step each deliver zero business value alone, so the four service-shaped candidates are one epic. It ships without the back office because gap-closed 7.8 provides seed catalogue and demo accounts.
merged_from: candidate EPIC-AUTH - enabler; a login screen delivers no business value on its own (test 1)
candidate EPIC-CHECKOUT - cannot promise an item without the reservation candidate (test 3)
candidate EPIC-INVENTORY reservation half - exists only to make checkout honest (test 3)
candidate EPIC-ORDER customer-tracking half - the same purchase outcome seen after the fact (test 3)

in: own-order tracking against a frozen price snapshot

tier_signals: customer-facing flow carrying direct personal data (gap-closed 15)
money movement through a payment provider, though PCI scope is avoided (gap-closed 18)
no KYC, AML or sanctions regime in play, so not T1

story_refs.title: Customer signs in to their own account
Customer continues a session without signing in again
Customer checks out at a server-computed total
Customer pays through the mock provider without being charged twice
Stock is held at confirm and released when payment does not complete
Customer tracks their own order at the price they agreed
